Blueface, whose real name is Jonathan Porter, is a Los Angeles rapper who rose to mainstream fame in the late 2010s with his unconventional, off-beat flow and viral approach to music. He broke out in 2018 with songs like “Respect My Cryppin’” and “Thotiana,” with “Thotiana” becoming his signature hit after receiving major remixes featuring artists such as Cardi B and YG. His unique delivery quickly became one of the most recognizable styles in West Coast hip-hop, helping him build a massive following online and eventually leading to a deal with Cash Money West.

Beyond music, Blueface has become a major internet personality whose relationships, family life, livestreams, business ventures and controversial moments regularly make headlines across social media. His ability to turn real-life situations into viral content has kept him in the spotlight even outside of releasing music. Despite the controversies surrounding him, Blueface remains one of the most recognizable rappers to emerge from Los Angeles during the late-2010s rap era, with “Thotiana” serving as the record that cemented his place in mainstream hip-hop.
